Band.description: A pay band in minor units of `currency`. Policy, not anyone's pay: never hidden.
Band.title: Band

ByDepartment.description: docs/09 section 3.2: in local currency for one currency's countries, else in USD.
ByDepartment.title: ByDepartment

ByJobTitle.description: docs/09 section 3.3: always in the country's currency.
ByJobTitle.title: ByJobTitle

CohortEquity.description: One job role + level + country against its band. Ratios are 2-decimal strings.
CohortEquity.title: CohortEquity

Comp.description: Which amount a salary filter or statistic uses: the base or the total compensation.
Comp.title: Comp

ComponentIn.description: An annual allowance or bonus target, in the salary's currency.
ComponentIn.title: ComponentIn

ComponentType.description: A salary component on top of base pay (ADR 0010).
ComponentType.title: ComponentType

CountryStats.description: One country: in its own currency, and with each salary converted to USD.
CountryStats.title: CountryStats

CurrentSalary.description: The salary record the current salary comes from.
CurrentSalary.title: CurrentSalary

DepartmentCost.description: One department's pay bill: the sum of its people's amounts (docs/09 section 3.5).
DepartmentCost.title: DepartmentCost

DepartmentCosts.description: In local currency (with USD next to it) for one currency's countries, else in USD.
DepartmentCosts.title: DepartmentCosts

EmployeeListItem.description:
An employee in a list. Without SALARY_READ the salary fields are null and
`salary_masked` is true (docs/07-api-spec.md section 1.7).
EmployeeListItem.title: EmployeeListItem

EmployeeUpdate.description:
Profile fields only. Salary, role, level and country change through a salary change,
so history explains them; they are refused here as unknown fields.
EmployeeUpdate.title: EmployeeUpdate

Features.description: Optional features. `ask` is false when no LLM_API_KEY is configured.
Features.title: Features

HireSalary.description: The first salary. `currency` may be left out: it is always the country's currency.
HireSalary.title: HireSalary

JobFamily.description: The pay family of a job role; the seed's band multipliers use it (docs/12 section 3).
JobFamily.title: JobFamily

JobRoleRef.description: A job role as other resources show it.
JobRoleRef.title: JobRoleRef

Level.description: Job level: L1 Associate, L2 Mid, L3 Senior, L4 Lead/Staff, L5 Principal, L6 Director.
Level.title: Level

LoginResponse.description: The signed-in user and the permissions of their current role.
LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse

Money.description: An exact amount: integer minor units of an ISO 4217 currency, never a float.
Money.title: Money

Overview.description: docs/09 section 3.1. `stats` is in `currency`: the population's one currency, else USD.
Overview.title: Overview

PayEquitySummary.description:
Who was evaluated, who was left out and why, and who was flagged.

For a caller without SALARY_READ, all counts are null when fewer than 5 were evaluated.
PayEquitySummary.title: PayEquitySummary

Population.description: The filters actually applied. An empty list means no condition on that field.
Population.title: Population

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Some problems add members, e.g. `current_version`.
Problem.title: Problem

ReferenceData.description: Every dropdown value, and what filters are validated against (docs/07 section 5).
ReferenceData.title: ReferenceData

SalaryBasis.description: How salaries in different currencies are compared: in local currency, or in USD.
SalaryBasis.title: SalaryBasis

SalaryChangeRequest.description: A new salary record. Role, level and country default to the current ones.
SalaryChangeRequest.title: SalaryChangeRequest

SalaryReason.description: Why a salary record was written.
SalaryReason.title: SalaryReason

Stats.description:
One group's statistics in minor units of `currency` (docs/07 section 8.2).

Percentiles interpolate linearly; mean and percentiles are rounded half-even.
Stats.title: Stats

Thresholds.description:
Compa-ratio limits as decimal strings: below `low` is UNDERPAID, above `high` is
OVERPAID, and a department whose median is below `rollup` is below threshold.
Thresholds.title: Thresholds

TopEarners.description: docs/09 section 3.6: individuals, so SALARY_READ only. Ties go by employee code.
TopEarners.title: TopEarners

ValidationProblem.description: 422 `validation`: one entry in `errors` per invalid field.
ValidationProblem.title: ValidationProblem

BearerToken.description: The same JWT as `Authorization: Bearer` (server-side fetches).

SessionCookie.description: The session JWT that POST /auth/login sets (browsers).
SessionCookie.name: session
